name: com.isitlegitreviews/isitlegit
title: Is it legit? Review trust checker
description: Scores whether a business's Google Maps reviews are genuine. Your agent collects them, we judge.

tools.name: describe_review_source
tools.description: Read this BEFORE scraping. Returns, per platform, the exact submission format: identity fields for the listing, the per-review fields (required vs optional; everything required is visible on the review card), where each lives on the platform's pages, the sort-by-newest and 500-most-recent rules, an example payload, and how to deliver it. Without a platform it lists the supported platforms. Only Google Maps exists today.

tools.name: check_place
tools.description: Call first. Resolves a Google Maps link or place_id and reports whether a trust result is cached, how fresh it is, and a recommendation: use the cached result, or collect and submit the reviews (also when a cached single-source result would benefit from your corroboration). Never contacts Google.

place_id.description: Google's feature id for the place (0x…:0x…, the '!1s' segment of a /maps/place URL).

url.description: Alternative to place_id: a Google Maps place link (long /maps/place/… URL or ?cid= link). Share short-links cannot be resolved; open them first.

tools.name: fetch_place_reviews
tools.description: Fallback for when you cannot reach a browser tab signed in to Google. Queues a server-side pull of the listing's newest reviews (the same worker as the site's form) and scores it. Ask the user first: it spends one of their server-side fetches for the month (check_place's serverFetch block says how many are left, or that the account has no limit; quote only that, never a plan's allowance from elsewhere). Returns the job's progress; call again with job_id every 10-15 seconds until status is done (the result is then in the response) or failed (nothing is spent). Takes a Maps link, including share short-links, or a place_id. A place that is already scored returns its result without a fetch, unless refetch=true: then it is pulled again, whatever its age, when the user wants it checked again (the same ask-first rule). A refetch that could not update the stored result ends as failed and spends nothing.

place_id.description: Google's feature id for the place (0x…:0x…, the '!1s' segment of a /maps/place URL).

url.description: Alternative to place_id: any Google Maps place link, share short-links included (the server's browser expands them).

job_id.description: A job from an earlier call: returns its progress, or the result once done.

refetch.description: Pull the place again even though it is already scored. Only when the user wants it checked again: it spends a server fetch like any other.

tools.name: begin_submission
tools.description: Reserves a submission and returns an upload_url. POST the complete JSON payload (format from describe_review_source) to it from your own environment or the user's browser; the HTTP response is the trust report. The URL is a secret that completes the submission under YOUR identity whoever posts to it, so the POST needs no key. Alternatively feed the same submission_id to submit_reviews in inline chunks. Pending submissions expire after 2 hours (or are closed as superseded when you one-shot the same place instead).

place_id.description: Google's feature id for the place (0x…:0x…, the '!1s' segment of a /maps/place URL).

url.description: Alternative to place_id: a Google Maps place link (long /maps/place/… URL or ?cid= link). Share short-links cannot be resolved; open them first.

expected_reviews.description: The review count the listing shows, if known.

agent.description: Your agent/product name, recorded as the submission's provenance (e.g. 'Muse', 'Claude Code').

tools.name: submit_reviews
tools.description: Submit the review feed inside the tool call. Without submission_id this is a one-shot submission of the whole payload (fine up to about 150 reviews). For more, call begin_submission, then send chunks of up to 150 reviews each with the same submission_id and final=false; send final=true with the last chunk (the identity fields may arrive with any chunk). Use this only when you cannot POST to the upload_url yourself (no page fetch, no curl): retyping reviews you already hold in a page or script is slow and error-prone. Returns the trust report when finalized.

submission_id.description: From begin_submission (omit for a one-shot submission).

final.description: With submission_id: true when this is the last chunk (default true).

platform.description: Which review source the data follows (describe_review_source).

cid.description: Decimal cid from a ?cid= link, when placeId is unknown.

listedReviews.description: The review count Google displays on the listing.

ratingHistogram.description: The five-bar rating histogram next to the star rating, as review counts for 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 stars IN THAT ORDER (Google draws 5 stars first; reverse what you read). Each bar's accessibility label or tooltip has the exact count. Required with a window or capped feed.

complete.description: True only if the review list reached its end; false for a newest-first window of the 500 most recent reviews (at least 200).

capped.description: True when deliberately stopped at 5000+ reviews of a much larger listing.

pulledAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime of collection (relative dates are resolved against it).

sort.description: The order collected in: 'newest' (required for a window) or 'relevant'.

agent.description: Your agent/product name, recorded as the submission's provenance (e.g. 'Muse', 'Claude Code').

takeaways.description: Optional: your summary of the reviews you collected, shown on the place's page (never scored). Three lists of up to 6 short plain-English sentences, drawn from reviews by established accounts: pros (what recent reviewers praise), cons (what they complain about), tips (practical advice: what to order, when to go, what to avoid). Or send it after finalizing with submit_takeaways.

authorReviewCount.description: Lifetime review count shown under the name ('12 reviews').

date.description: The relative date as displayed, in English ('3 months ago', 'Edited 2 weeks ago'; translate it to that form yourself if your Google is not in English). Required unless timestamp is given.

text.description: Original-language text; omit for star-only reviews.

reviewId.description: Optional: Google's review id (data-review-id on the card).

timestamp.description: Optional: exact posting time, epoch µs/ms/s, when you have it (row[0][1][2]).

editedTimestamp.description: Optional: last-edit time in the same units (row[0][1][3]), when present.

source.description: Platform the card attributes the review to, on listings that show several (hotels). Send Google reviews only; others are dropped.

tools.name: finalize_submission
tools.description: For a submission fed by inline chunks: validates, scores, stores and returns the report. For one already uploaded to its upload_url: returns the stored report. Pending with nothing uploaded yet: says so.

tools.name: submit_takeaways
tools.description: After a submission is finalized: send the summary you give the user of what recent reviewers praise (pros), complain about (cons) and advise (tips), up to 6 short plain-English sentences per list, drawn from reviews by established accounts rather than one-off ones. It is shown on the place's page next to the trust result and never affects the score. The same lists can travel inside the submission payload as `takeaways` instead. Only an accepted or kept submission can carry one; calling again replaces yours.

submission_id.description: The finalized submission these lists summarize (from begin_submission / submit_reviews).

tools.name: get_place_trust
tools.description: The cached fraud analysis for a place: verdict (looks_legit / not_sure / past_manipulation / inflated / manipulated) with its label and a one-sentence summary, letter grade, 0-100 trust score, the adjusted rating credible reviewers actually give (vs the headline average), reviewer-mix tiers, review-injection statistics, cross-business duplicate-review evidence, red flags, and provenance. Cache only: on a miss, collect and submit the reviews (see check_place).

place_id.description: Google's feature id for the place (0x…:0x…, the '!1s' segment of a /maps/place URL).

url.description: Alternative to place_id: a Google Maps place link (long /maps/place/… URL or ?cid= link). Share short-links cannot be resolved; open them first.

tools.name: list_scored_places
tools.description: The ranked directory of places already analyzed for review fraud, best adjusted rating first (what the site's home and city pages show). 25 per page. Optional city or curated-list filter; the response lists the available cities/lists and their counts.

city.description: Limit to one city's places (a slug from the `cities` field of a previous response).

list.description: Limit to one curated list's places.
